knownGaps: Donut's character level 1 is strongly implied by later progression and prior site data but is not directly printed in the corpus, so this audit begins her explicit level timeline at 2.
Neither Carl nor Donut receives a separately anchored character-level display for 4 or 6; the next explicit shared displays are 5 and 7.
Donut's character level 11 is not separately displayed; the next explicit shared display is 12.
Mongo has no explicitly displayed stat values, skills, spells, or skill-level changes in Book 1.
Several bulk skill-upgrade passages omit names or final numbers; those events are retained as incomplete rather than silently expanded.
The narrator often collapses low-tier box contents into phrases such as usual potions, torches, biscuits, or crap; exact running counts cannot be recovered from the prose.
Many combat potion uses are implied rather than individually narrated, so consumable totals are lower-bound evidence, not ledger-perfect balances.
The book never exposes Donut's full inventory to Carl; only narrated, equipped, transferred, or opened items can be audited.
Bulk salvage is intentionally grouped rather than expanding every wrench, chair, file, or weight into a separate event.
